semantic_axes.description: Definitive evidence or an answer settles a disputed issue authoritatively, whereas definite information is simply clear, fixed, or certain.

edges.boundary_rule: Definitive evidence or an answer settles a disputed issue authoritatively, whereas definite information is simply clear, fixed, or certain.

misconceptions.M2: Treating final authority as mere specificity.
misconceptions.M3: Assuming a detailed draft is an accepted verdict.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mina's departure plan?

beats.text: Mina has booked a train leaving at exactly 8:15 on Friday.
The confirmation arrives in a brightly coloured email.
beats.reason: The colour of the confirmation does not make the timetable an authoritative settlement of a dispute.

chains.feedback_short: The colour of the confirmation does not make the timetable an authoritative settlement of a dispute.
chains.feedback_deep: Definitive means authoritative or conclusive enough to settle a matter. Definite means clear, certain, or fixed without necessarily resolving a wider dispute. The colour of the confirmation does not make the timetable an authoritative settlement of a dispute.
chains.contrast_rule: Definite is clear; definitive settles the matter.

hints.attention: Notice the status of the departure time.
hints.axis: Definitive evidence or an answer settles a disputed issue authoritatively, whereas definite information is simply clear, fixed, or certain.
hints.contrast: Definite is clear; definitive settles the matter.
